funding.supported_assets_note: Unsecured US credit card (Mastercard World Elite) repaid in USD; rewards are paid in the cardholder's chosen cryptocurrency (bitcoin by default) into a Gemini exchange account.

credit_terms.liquidation_risk: Unsecured credit card: no crypto collateral and no liquidation. APR, cash-advance, late and returned-payment fees are set out in the WebBank cardholder agreement (dated 2026-04-01, filed with the CFPB), which the fetcher received as binary data and could not read — all interest terms are recorded as unknown. Rewards already paid can be clawed back as a 'Rewards Charge' on returns.

eligibility.usage_note: Support centre: 'U.S. residents in all 50 states' may apply; 'the Gemini Credit Card will not be available outside of the U.S.' Approval also requires approval for a Gemini Exchange account and a hard credit inquiry. Not available to residents of Europe or anywhere else outside the US.

kyc.stages_note: Credit application: identity checked 'against several sources'; hard inquiry on the credit report (Experian and Clarity must be unfrozen); approval for a Gemini Exchange account is mandatory; withdrawing rewards requires completing Gemini's BSA/AML identity verification. Specific documents (SSN, ID) are not listed on the pages read.

access.note: No annual fee; subject to credit approval.

fees.conditions: 'No annual fee' (landing page and support centre). The rewards agreement reserves the right to introduce 'an annual Rewards Program membership fee' in the future.
'No foreign transaction fees' (landing page). Not confirmed against the cardholder agreement (unreadable to the fetcher).
Cash advances exist (excluded from rewards and from the referral purchase requirement) but the cash-advance fee and APR are in the unreadable cardholder agreement.
Credit card: there is no top-up; purchases are repaid by statement in USD. Interest applies to carried balances (APR unknown).

excluded_categories: card account fees and interest charges
gift cards, prepaid cards and reloads, cash equivalents
precious metals, casino chips, lottery tickets, gaming
rewards.conditions: 1% on 'all other qualifying purchases'. Paid in the cardholder's chosen eligible digital asset (bitcoin if none chosen; '50+ cryptos available on Gemini'); most rewards deposited at authorisation ('Instant Rewards'), others when the transaction posts. Requires a Gemini account in good standing.

4% on gas at the pump, EV charging, transit, taxis and rideshare, 'capped at $300 in monthly spend'; 1% for the rest of the calendar month above the cap. Gas bought inside a store or at a kiosk does not qualify. Merchant coding (MCC) decides.
3% on dining (traditional restaurants, bars/nightclubs, fast food). Delivery services such as Uber Eats may not be coded as dining. No cap stated.

excluded_categories: Costco, Sam's Club, Walmart, Target (usually not coded as grocery)
rewards.conditions: 2% on groceries (traditional grocery and specialty food stores). No cap stated.

Mastercard World Elite benefits named on the pages read: ID Theft Protection, Zero Liability, Price Protection, merchant offers (DoorDash, Lyft), 24/7 live agent support. 'Vault Rewards' merchant promotions up to 10% at selected brands, limits not published.
rewards.description: Mastercard World Elite benefits and merchant offers

evidence.title: The Gemini Credit Card — product page
evidence.excerpt: 'issued by WebBank'; Mastercard World Elite; 'no annual fee'; 'No foreign transaction fees'; 4% gas/EV/transit 'up to $300 in spend/month' then 1%, 3% dining, 2% groceries, 1% everything else; rewards in bitcoin or '50+ cryptos'; referral $50 per friend, $250 bonus every 5 referrals, up to 50/year. APR not stated (links to rates/fees not retrievable).

evidence.title: Credit Card Crypto Rewards Program — Key Terms (dated March 4, 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Card issued by WebBank (Utah industrial bank); programme offered by Gemini Trust Company LLC / Gemini Moonbase LLC, serviced by Gemini Constellation LLC. Gemini account required; BSA/AML verification before withdrawing rewards. Default payout bitcoin at market price; Instant vs Post-Clear rewards. Exclusions incl. cash advances, gift cards, crypto. Possible future membership fee. No percentages.

evidence.title: Everyday Crypto Back Rewards Tiers (support centre)
evidence.excerpt: 4% gas & EV charging, transit, taxis & rideshare — 'The 4% back rate is capped at $300 in monthly spend', then 1% for the rest of the calendar month; 3% dining; 2% groceries (excl. Costco, Sam's Club, Walmart, candy stores, bakeries); 1% all other. MCC assigned by merchant processor. Past promos: 5% holiday 26 Nov–7 Dec 2025; 10% at selected merchants; golf 10% to 30 Sep 2025. No date.

evidence.title: Gemini Credit Card — Product Overview (support centre)
evidence.excerpt: 'WebBank … is the bank partner and issuer'; Mastercard 'the exclusive card network'; 'The card will have no annual fee'; 'U.S. residents in all 50 states' may apply; 'will not be available outside of the U.S.'; metal card in black, silver or rose gold; rewards paid 'at the time of purchase'. Page still quotes 'up to 3% back on dining' as the top rate (older than the 4% transit tier). No date.
evidence.contradiction_note: Overview says 'up to 3% back' (dining) while the landing page and the rewards-tiers article add a 4% gas/EV/transit tier capped at $300 spend per month. The dedicated rewards-tiers article governs; the overview appears outdated.

evidence.title: Gemini Credit Card Application Process (support centre)
evidence.excerpt: Hard inquiry on the credit report on behalf of WebBank; identity verified 'against several sources'; Experian and Clarity freezes must be lifted; 'you must also be approved for a Gemini Exchange account'; metal card mailed within 5–7 days of approval; no virtual card mentioned. No date.

evidence.title: Gemini Credit Card Referral Program Terms (dated December 19, 2025)
evidence.excerpt: Referrer $50 in crypto per approved friend who makes one eligible purchase in the first billing cycle; referee $50 on activation; $250 'bonus multiplier' on the 5th referral in a rolling 12 months; max 50 referrals and $5,000 per calendar year; 'marketing affiliates are not eligible to participate'. Cardholders only.

evidence.title: Does Gemini have an Affiliate program? (support centre)
evidence.excerpt: 'The Gemini Affiliate Program': application reviewed by Gemini; unique referral link; performance tracked 'via the Impact platform'; flat '$25 per converted account' when a new user 'places a trade'; paid in 'your preferred currency of choice'. The credit card is not named as a paid action.

changelog.reason: Initial record from seven official Gemini pages (landing page, rewards agreement, rewards-tiers article, product overview, application process, referral terms, affiliate article) read by the unattended research run. US-only unsecured credit card. The WebBank cardholder agreement (CFPB filing, 2026-04-01) was returned as binary data and could not be read: APR and cash-advance/late/returned-payment fees unknown. Single read; second read required before publication. Scope decision needed (US-only product in a Europe-first catalogue).
Out of scope (David, 2026-11-02): US-only products are not listed; the catalogue targets the EEA. Record kept for history; it will not be researched further or published.
Re-opened: David made the site global on 2026-11-07 (US products in scope). Values date from the earlier read; a second independent read is required before publication.

Second independent read on 2026-11-08 (fetcher, 6 days after the 2026-11-02 first read) of all seven evidence pages — every material value confirmed, unchanged: issuer 'Issued by WebBank.' (landing) / 'WebBank, a leader in digital lending, is the bank partner and issuer' (overview) / 'a Utah state-chartered industrial bank' (rewards agreement, still dated March 4, 2026); network 'Mastercard® World Elite' (landing), 'Mastercard, the exclusive card network' (overview); 'No annual fee'; 'No foreign transaction fees'; rewards 4% gas, EV and transit 'on up to $300 in spend per month' then 1% ('The 4% back rate is capped at $300 in monthly spend', refresh on the 1st of each calendar month), 3% dining, 2% groceries (excl. Costco, Sam's Club, Walmart, candy stores, bakeries), 1% everything else, MCC decides; payout 'bitcoin, or 50+ cryptos available on Gemini', Instant vs Post-Clear rewards, Rewards Charge clawback, possible future membership fee, Vault Rewards up to 10%; eligibility 'Residents in all 50 U.S. states will be eligible to apply' and 'will not be available outside of the U.S.'; application: hard inquiry on behalf of WebBank, Experian and Clarity freezes to lift, Gemini Exchange account approval mandatory, metal card within 5–7 days; referral terms (December 19, 2025) $50 / $50 / $250 per 5 / max 50 and $5,000 per year, marketing affiliates excluded; affiliate article: $25 per converted account via Impact. Product status active ('Get started'; no waitlist or discontinuation wording). APR, cash-advance, late and returned-payment fees still unread: gemini.com/legal/cardholder-agreement now links a cardholder agreement dated September 25, 2026 (PDF on assets.ctfassets.net, not fetchable by the fetcher) — the record's reference to the 2026-04-01 CFPB filing is a stale pointer, the values stay unknown. Non-material wording differences, none overwritten: the overview labels the benefits 'World Mastercard® Benefits' (the landing page says 'Mastercard® World Elite'; DoorDash/Lyft/ID Theft/Zero Liability/Price Protection appear on the overview only, not on the landing page); the overview says 'more than 40 cryptocurrencies' vs the landing page's '50+ cryptos'; quotes 'U.S. residents in all 50 states' and 'against several sources' are paraphrases of 'Residents in all 50 U.S. states…' and 'We use several sources to verify identification'; the rewards-tiers article no longer lists the 2025 holiday and golf promotions and now names the 10% merchants (Ridge Wallet, David Protein, Create Gummies, Huron, Othership, Masa Chips, Cadence; no dates, no caps). New official information not modelled: a Business Card exists ('Consumer or Business' in the rewards agreement; /credit-card/business); the $200-for-$3,000 intro bonus was paused on 2026-01-31 (intro-promo terms dated January 27, 2026) — no sign-up bonus is offered today; pre-qualification without credit-score impact; 'Up to $5,000 credit limit, Additional income verification needed'; card editions Bitcoin / Solana / XRP / Zcash; referral rewards over $600 per year reported on Form 1099-MISC.
Second independent read on 2026-11-08: all material values confirmed.

editorial.summary: US-only Mastercard World Elite credit card issued by WebBank, with no annual fee and no foreign transaction fee, paying 1% to 4% back in the cardholder's chosen cryptocurrency (bitcoin by default). It is an unsecured credit card: interest applies to carried balances and the APR could not be read from the official agreement.
good_for: US residents who want crypto rewards on a no-annual-fee credit card and pay their balance in full
Transit, rideshare, gas and EV-charging spend up to $300 a month (4%)
not_for: Anyone outside the United States (not available)
People who carry a balance: credit-card interest (APR unknown here) outweighs 1–4% rewards
Users who want a virtual card or spend crypto directly (rewards only; purchases are repaid in USD)
watch_outs: APR, cash-advance fee, late fee and returned-payment fee are in the WebBank cardholder agreement, which the fetcher could not read — recorded as unknown, never as zero.
Rewards are paid at market price in a volatile asset; the landing page's '277% appreciation' claim is backward-looking marketing.
Merchant category coding decides the rate: warehouse clubs, Walmart and Target usually earn only 1%.
A Gemini exchange account in good standing is mandatory to receive and withdraw rewards.
